segments.contextAfter: Prior to iOS 16, you can add an [`AVCaptureVideoDataOutput`](avcapturevideodataoutput.md) and an [`AVCaptureMovieFileOutput`](avcapturemoviefileoutput.md) to the same session, but only one may have its connection active. If you attempt to enable both connections, the system chooses the movie file output as the active connection and disables the video data output’s connection. For apps that link against iOS 16 or later, this restriction no longer exists.
